decision: SHELVE standalone untreated-kinetics or metabolic-phenotype paper from this bounded gate
scientific_value: Known indolence and rare regressions are the authors' reported observations. The published numerical primary interval changes do not supply a new untreated lung comparator. Stable disease or modest shrinkage alone cannot establish treatment attribution, but this is established design caution rather than a new disease finding.
reopening_condition: Independent authenticated EMC cohort with complete case-linked serial lesion dimensions/acquisition dates during documented untreated intervals, comparator controls or mechanistically discriminating measurements; all relevant suitable sources evaluated before promotion.
